scope: Real native Copilot and Mac2 applications, synthetic task-owned local documents only

native.limits: Only allowlisted status, identity, timestamp, and digest evidence is retained. Absent event timestamps remain null; raw code, arguments, output, final prose, and stderr are withheld.

limits: No personal contents or raw tool/code/Appium logs retained.
Window identities are digest-bound application-element/title facts because the installed Mac2 driver exposes no WebDriver window-handle endpoints.
Response-only synthetic matches are retained separately from request matches.
Observed file equality and app state do not prove global desktop or application-history restoration.
Appium target action evidence is cross-checked with independent disk state, not final prose alone.
